_comment: DEV curated drug-drug interaction dataset (ONC high-priority style, 09 D7). Each rule matches by ingredient OR class on each side. Severity: contraindicated | major | moderate. Clinician-curated, versioned; production augments with DrugBank-open / TWOSIDES keyed by RxCUI.

rules.rationale: NSAIDs markedly increase bleeding risk with warfarin (antiplatelet effect + GI irritation + protein-binding displacement).
Additive bleeding risk; combine only with a specific indication and gastroprotection.
Macrolides raise INR (CYP inhibition) — bleeding risk.
CYP3A4 inhibition raises statin levels — myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk (esp. simvastatin).
Additive hyperkalaemia risk — monitor potassium and renal function.
Serotonin syndrome — combination is contraindicated; observe washout period.
Risk of life-threatening serotonin syndrome with MAOIs.
Additive antifolate effect — bone-marrow suppression risk.
NSAIDs reduce methotrexate clearance — toxicity risk (esp. high-dose MTX).
Amiodarone raises digoxin levels — toxicity; reduce digoxin dose and monitor.
Omeprazole may reduce clopidogrel activation (CYP2C19) — prefer pantoprazole.
Increased GI bleeding risk — consider gastroprotection.
